propositions: CLI facade reconstructs command identity through 19 overlapping frozensets and regex-based generation, with parser/help drift undetected until census update.
Twenty-one intercept-only commands lack canonical help and report unknown to 'rebar help' while handler --help is inconsistent and may execute work.
Parser grammar must be generated once by side-effect-free argparse factory and reused identically for both execution and documentation generation.
Help and unknown-command output must read committed package-help bytes before operation snapshot, config materialization, or handler resolution.
Lazy execution must preserve all mount/init, argv, confirmation, stream, exit-code, and legacy-output contracts except approved help normalization.
Semantic capability registry must map capabilities to backend availability postures (error/unavailable/abstain/fallback) without eager optional imports.
